newsitem.title: USA: Minnesota Power gets long-term contract.
newsitem.headline: Minnesota Power gets long-term contract.

text.p: Minnesota Power & Light Co said Wednesday it negotiated a long-term electric power contract to serve USX-U.S. Steel Group's Minntac taconite iron mining operation on Minnesota's Iron Range.
Minntac annually produces about 14 million tons of taconite pellets used as raw material to produce steel.
The agreement provides for Minnesota Power to remain Minntac's sole electricity supplier for the next 11 years.
The agreement is subject to approval of the Minnesota Public Utilities Commission.
